also: many happy returns of the day

phrases.latin: At tū, Nātālis multōs celebrande per annōs, candidior semper candidiorque venī.
phrases.english: And you, Birthday, may you be kept for many years to come: come ever brighter, and brighter still.

phrases.latin: Dīcāmus bona verba: venit Nātālis ad ārās.
phrases.english: Let us speak words of good omen: the Birthday comes to the altar.

phrases.latin: Fēlīcem nātālem tibi exoptō, mī fīlī; utinam hunc diem multōs per annōs celebrēs!
phrases.english: Happy birthday, my son, and many happy returns of the day!

sources: Lewis & Short: natalis · Lewis & Short: celebro
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 280.
